mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_daily_snapshot ( market_date, source_subject, pdf_file_name, pdf_url, raw_text, summary_text, market_headline_text, market_detail_text, kospi, kosdaq, nasdaq, usdkrw, treasury_3y ) VALUES ( #{marketDate}, #{sourceSubject}, #{pdfFileName}, #{pdfUrl}, #{rawText}, #{summaryText}, #{marketHeadlineText}, #{marketDetailText}, #{kospi}, #{kosdaq}, #{nasdaq}, #{usdkrw}, #{treasury3y} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE market_date = VALUES(market_date), source_subject = VALUES(source_subject), pdf_file_name = VALUES(pdf_file_name), pdf_url = VALUES(pdf_url), raw_text = VALUES(raw_text), summary_text = VALUES(summary_text), kospi = VALUES(kospi), kosdaq = VALUES(kosdaq), nasdaq = VALUES(nasdaq), usdkrw = VALUES(usdkrw), treasury_3y = VALUES(treasury_3y), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, market_date, source_subject, pdf_file_name, pdf_url, raw_text, summary_text, market_headline_text, market_detail_text, kospi, kosdaq, nasdaq, usdkrw, treasury_3y, created_at, updated_at FROM market_daily_snapshot WHERE pdf_file_name = #{pdfFileName}

SELECT id, market_date, source_subject, pdf_file_name, pdf_url, raw_text, summary_text, market_headline_text, market_detail_text, kospi, kosdaq, nasdaq, usdkrw, treasury_3y, created_at, updated_at FROM market_daily_snapshot WHERE market_date = #{marketDate} AND source_subject = #{sourceSubject}

SELECT id, market_date, source_subject, pdf_file_name, pdf_url, raw_text, summary_text, market_headline_text, market_detail_text, kospi, kosdaq, nasdaq, usdkrw, treasury_3y, created_at, updated_at FROM market_daily_snapshot WHERE market_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY market_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, market_date, source_subject, pdf_file_name, pdf_url, raw_text, summary_text, market_headline_text, market_detail_text, kospi, kosdaq, nasdaq, usdkrw, treasury_3y, created_at, updated_at FROM market_daily_snapshot WHERE market_date = #{marketDate} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, market_date, source_subject, pdf_file_name, pdf_url, raw_text, summary_text, market_headline_text, market_detail_text, kospi, kosdaq, nasdaq, usdkrw, treasury_3y, created_at, updated_at FROM market_daily_snapshot WHERE market_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND market_headline_text IS NOT NULL AND market_headline_text != '' AND market_detail_text IS NOT NULL AND market_detail_text != '' ORDER BY market_date DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE market_daily_snapshot SET market_headline_text = #{marketHeadlineText}, market_detail_text = #{marketDetailText}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE market_daily_snapshot SET market_headline_text = #{marketHeadlineText}, market_detail_text = #{marketDetailText}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND (market_headline_text IS NULL OR market_headline_text = '' OR market_detail_text IS NULL OR market_detail_text = '')
